batting.dismissal: c R Parag b PWH de Silva

batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b PWH de Silva

batting.dismissal: c SB Dubey b TU Deshpande

batting.name: V Suryavanshi

batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b Avesh Khan

balls.text: And six to end the over! Wowza! Samad, the star. Knee-high full toss outside off, Samad clears his front leg and hammers this over deep midwicket. That went very, very high and over deep midwicket. 27 off the final over and LSG finish on 180 for 5.
Is that a six again? Oh, yes, the ball has hit the the boundary ropes on the full. Slower back of a length ball outside off, he gets in position and swats it to the right of deep backward square leg
Pace off on a length on off stump, Samad gets it off the cue-end of the bat but over Sandeep's head. Gets two more
Six more! Slower back of a length ball outside off, he nails the pull to the right of deep midwicket
Tries the yorker, misses his length and Samad picks this for six. On his pads and Samad helps this over deep backward square leg
Slower short of a length ball well outside off, Miller can only flat-bat this to long-off
Another yorker. Terrific stuff from Archer. Miller backs away but the pacer follows him and spears this ball on his pad. Only a leg-bye
Change of pace now. Slower back of a length and Samad is beaten for lack of pace. The ball hits his thigh pad and they take a leg-bye
That is a terrific yorker from Archer. Not much Miller can do with these. Spears it on his toes as he was backing away. He gets his bat down in time and gets an under-edge to the keeper

On-pace bouncer aiming for Miller's body. That's a good bumper, but is called a wide. Was that too high? Parag wants to have a second look. The graphic shows that the ball is under head-high but the third umpire over-rules it saying the graphic is wrong and the wide stands
Fuller-length ball homing in on middle stump, Samad backs away and gets this down to long-on
Miller backs away but Archer follows him and spears a length ball cramping him for room. Miller is hit on the pad and they can only get a leg-bye
Banged in short at pace aiming for Samad's body. He mistimes a pull towards deep midwicket. Wanted a second but is sent back
Banged in short on off, he pulls to Archer at deep backward square leg
On a length outside off, he drives to deep cover for a run
On a length on middle and leg, worked to deep square leg

Straight to deep cover and Badoni's innings ends on exactly 50. Back of a length ball outside off, he swats this away decently well but the placement is not on point. Hits it straight to Dubey, who initially over-runs, but settles himself and takes a good catch reverse-cupped over his head

Badoni's chance to get lucky now as he picks a four, and a fifty as well. Slower back of a length outside off. He eyes a reverse, but the ball catches his glove and lucky for him the ball balloons over the keeper's head.
Short and wide and Deshpande is lucky there as Badoni slaps the cut straight to point
Slower short of a length ball on off stump, Badoni gets a good chunk on the pull but hits it on the bounce to deep midwicket
On a length on leg stump, Miller nudges this to deep fine leg
Gives himself room again but Sandeep goes on pace this time on leg stump. Badoni has to be content with pushing this to long-on
Backs away and slaps this over covers. Top shot. Slower short of a length ball outside off. He gives himself room and swats it away
Slower legcutter on off stump that is cut straight to point
Angles the length ball on middle and leg stump. Miller ticks this to long-on
Tossed up on the fuller side on middle at 85kph. Miller is off the mark with  a flick to wide long-on

Tossed up well outside off and Markram is out of here. Slows this up at 84.9kph away from Markram's arc. He looks to go over long-off but gets it right off the bottom of the bat. Parag swallows up a relatively simple catch
Short and spinning away from Badoni who can only cut this to deep cover
Finally gets one in his arc and Badoni takes full toll. In the slot on leg stump and Badoni brings out the slog sweep and gets it over deep midwicket
Googly tossed up on leg stump. Markram eyes a big heave across the line and is hit on the midriff as the ball goes towards point
Legbreak on a length on off as Badoni stays back and pushes towards cover
And again. Top over from Theekshana. Fired fuller and very quick at middle stump. All Markram can do is jam this back to the bowler
Darts that very, very full at 108.7kph outside off, Markram lets that go but that was inside the tramline
Again, 108.6 fuller-length ball outside off, he can only squeeze this to as far as deep cover
Fired fuller on middle and leg, he digs this to long-off for a run
Fired in outside off, he carves this to deep point for a run
Quite a high full toss on off stump. Badoni gets down on one knee and swats this away to the right of deep midwicket
Fired in on off stump, Badoni steps down the track and looks to push this through the offside. Gets it off the inside half of the bat down to long-on
Quicker on leg stump, he works this to deep midwicket
Backs away too early and Hasaranga spots him. Follows him and pushes a quicker length ball which is worked to short fine leg
Googly, pushed quicker on middle and leg. He looks for a sweep, misses and is rapped on the midriff
Stifle short on middle as Badoni hops back and eases to long-off
Tossed up on a  length on middle, he prods forward and pushes to covers
Length ball on leg stump which Markram drags to deep midwicket. That is the longer part of the boundary and Hetmyer who was sprinting in fails to pick it cleanly. An easier two for the duo
Lovely delivery to end the over. Slower 108.3kph that dips late and lands almost yorker length on middle. Not much Markram could do but to jam it back to the bowler
beaten for lack of pace. Slower bouncer outside off, he is early into his pull and can't lay a bat on it
Low full toss on middle and leg, he bunts this to long-on for a run
Too short, too high, called a wide. Goes pace-on as he sees Badoni back away. The idea was good, not so much the execution
The right boot of Deshpande saves a few runs. Full on the stumps, Badoni slams a straight drive to the right of Deshpande, who sticks out his right leg
Wide? Yep. Slower good length ball well outside off. Badoni took  step to his right but the ball was comfortably outside the tramline
They pinch a quick single. Fullish in length on middle, Markram backs away and checks his drive, getting this to mid-off
Flatter offbreak outside off, he sweeps this in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Wrong'un just outside off stump. Badoni spots this early, stretches forward and works this to wide long-on
Fired in on middle and leg stump, he backs away and eases to long-off
Has he got enough on that? You betcha! Wasn't as short but Markram is so quick to pick lengths tonight. Quickly hops back and pulls this over long-on
Fuller and fired outside off, he stretches forward and opens the face of the bat to guide to deep point
Fatter on middle stump as Markram goes back and flat-bats to long-on
slower bouncer outside off, he pulls towards cow corner and immediately calls for two. Sixteen off that Sandeep over
And now some innovation. On a length outside off, he gets right across and plays a cheeky scoop to the left of the keeper as LSG get a move on
BANG! Back of a length ball outside off stump, he stays still and flat-bats this over mid-off for a one-bounce four.
A free flowing drive gets Markram three more and also a fifty. On a length outside off stump, Markram stretches forward and lines up a cover drive. Deep cover sprints to his right and saves a run
On a length homing in on middle stump, he stands tall and whisks to wide long-on
Good length ball outside off stump, he slashes this to deep third for a run
deep over long-on! Short from Hasaranga, who went around middle and off, and Markram shifted his weight back to club the ball by pulling it hard and high
bang down the ground! He waits for this full and slow ball to dip on off, and sends it flinging over the bowler's head for six
full and straight, and quicker too. Driven back to Hasaranga
fullish, and much slower on middle. It turns away, and is punched to deep midwicket

a lot more animation, confidence and expectation in this lbw appeal... but turned down!! Jurel and Hasaranga converge, and Parag, from long-off, signals for a review. Badoni looked to sweep, but the ball went below his bat. There's no bottom edge there, by the way. The ball hit Badoni's front knee around middle. It pitched on a short of a length on off, and straightened. And replays confirm that it is umpire's call on impact and hitting off
half an appeal for lbw, but there's an inside edge. He leaned forward to push at this full and slow ball dipping on middle and off, and didn't find the middle of the bat
on a length on off, and nudged to midwicket
excellent timing! Short of a length, and just outside off, as Badoni punches it late, and opens the face of the bat to beat point to his left, and deep third to his right
sharp bouncer! The ball lands short on off, and ends around leg or thereabouts. Badoni went hooking but missed, and it wasn't called wide as it seemed to be barely outside leg
he backs away, and punches at this back-of-a-length ball on middle. Punched to mid-off for a quick single
drives this aerially towards mid-off, as he leans into the shot off this length ball angling into middle
shorter side of a length on middle and off, and clipped to deep-backward square leg
wide for height. A bouncer just outside off, and Badoni swayed out of the way. The ball went very high in the end
slower, and full and just outside off. Driven to cover
he goes back, and pushes at this length ball around sixth stump which turns in. Single to deep midwicket

taken by Jurel on three juggles!! He eventually had to go low to grab the ball. It was a length ball from Hasaranga on off, and there was some extra bounce and some turn away. Pant went reverse sweeping, but got a top edge, with the ball going on to hit the grill of Jurel's helmet. From there, it dropped and went into his gloves, before Jurel took it after nearly dropping it
full and slower, and on middle and off. Driven to long-on
on a length, and angling across towards off. It hints to turn away, and is whipped to deep midwicket
starts with a googly, as this dips on a length just outside off. Cut away to deep cover point
fuller side of a length on off, and blocked back to Deshpande's right
shorter side of a length, and angling into middle and off. Driven to long-on
no foot movement there, as he simply dabs at this short-of-a-length ball on middle which is angling across. Single to deep third
he looks to slap at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off, but only manages to chop it towards mid-off
short of a length, and angling across to pitch on middle. Tucked towards point, and they set off for a single
starts with a short ball around off which straightens, and is punched to long-on
on a length, and angling away to arrive just outside off. It was a slower ball, and Pant jabbed it towards point
shorter side of a length on middle and off, and nudged towards square leg
slightly fuller, and angling across on off. Tapped back by Pant

Sandeep is convinced for another lbw, and appeals animatedly. Even Jurel thinks it's out, but it's not given. This time RR reivew. Pant was looking to dab at this short-of-a-length ball on middle, and UltraEdge confirms there's an inside edge

Sandeep hasn't even entirely completed his lbw appeal... and the umpire's finger is up! It looked that clear!! But Pooran has reviewed! Sandeep angled that in from around the wicket, and went on a very full length on off. Pooran looked to launch it across the line, but the ball skidded through to hit his back leg, which was deep in the crease. There's not bat involved, and ball tracking shows the ball would have hit the base of leg stump. So LSG lose Pooran and a review
driven back aerially, and for four! Full and angled into off, and Pooran played back powerfully just to Sandeep's right
swung past short fine leg. On the shorter side of a length from Archer, who ended up bowling wide of leg. Markram went after it, and placed it between the keeper and short fine
leading edge towards cover, as he looked to clip this back-of-a-length ball

Dubey drops a sitter!! He has dropped a batter who has been in form since 2024. Dubey was at square leg, and waited for the ball, which was swirling miles up in the air, to arrive. Jurel, the keeper, nearly got there, and they nearly collided, after Pooran went swiping at this short ball on middle
flies off the top edge! Short in length, and slightly wide of off from Archer, as Pooran went slashing hard at it. The pace on the ball meant the ball took off from the bat

clipped aerially over midwicket... and that's a good chase from Hetmyer from deep-backward square leg. He ran and dived to his left to prevent a boundary, after Archer bowled on the shorter side and shaped it into leg
legcutter beats Markram! It was bowled short while angling into middle. The ball shaped away and finished outside off, as Markram looked to jab but missed
full and straight, and driven to long-on
slapped to deep cover point! Markram is in great touch, as he shifts his weight back and cuts hard at this shortish delivery just outside off
swept to short fine leg, where there's a fumble, and they get a run. Full and quick, and outside leg from Theekshana, as Pooran got down to attack at that
yorker length, and it hits Markram's front toe on leg. He went flicking but missed, and the ball trickled towards square leg
fuller in length, and around fifth stump. Cut away on the bounce to point
punched wide of mid-off! He gets his front leg out of the way, and finds the room to dispatch this short-of-a-length ball on middle which turns in a bit
on a length, and darted in outside leg. Markram lets it go, and it's called wide
this is fuller, and angling across to come on off. Defensive pushed to cover
angled in, and on a short of a length on middle. The ball ends near leg, and is clipped to fine leg
short ball again, but this angles across and pitches on middle and off. Dabbed towards short third for a single
a bouncer to welcome Pooran! Archer bangs it on middle, and Pooran ducks. The ball flies off the pitch and into the keeper's gloves

well taken by Hetmyer! He was placed at deep-backward square leg, and ran forward while keeping his eyes on the ball along, and taking the catch just past the 30-yard circle. Archer kept pumping the short balls at the openers, and this one got big on Marsh around off stump. There was some extra bounce, and as Marsh went hooking, the ball took off from the top half of the bat
there's a deep-backward point in place, and Markram rides the bounce of this short ball just outside off to slap it there
fuller ball, and angling into his pads. Clipped to deep midwicket as he opens his stance up
shorter side of a length on off, as Marsh gets across the stumps and drives off the back foot to long-on
oh this straightens after pitching on a length around sixth stump. Again pushed to cover
this turns in off a length from outside off, and finishes on off. Punched to mid-off
again on length, and this dips just outside off. Marsh shapes to smash, before pushing it back towards the bowler
floats this on a length as it drifts in towards off. Punched to long-on by Markram
great fielding by Sandeep at mid-off! He threw himself to his left to keep this to a single, as Markram drove forward at this length delivery around off
hacked for four more! This time Markram finds the gap with a forceful cut between short third and point, as he picks this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump, and slaps it away

slashed just wide of the man at extra cover, from where Dubey chases the ball all the way back and even tries to pull it back, but in vain. Archer keeps bowling short, and this time goes slightly wide of off, as Markram slashes at it although not with great timing
short in length again, and just outside off. This finishes on top of off, and is punched back
short in length on off, and seams back in sharply to take the inside edge as Markram looked to fend it away

driven down aerially... and well saved by Parag! On a fullish length, an just outside off, as Marsh drove but the bat turned in his hands. Parag, from mid-on, turned around and gave the chase to pull the ball back last moment

LSG win by two runs! That is unbelievable. Fuller on the stumps, Dubey hammers this straight back at Avesh, who gets hit on the right hand. He rings his hand in pain. But that doesn't matter. What matters is that LSG have won what at one point felt like an unwinnable game. And RR... oh my word! They have lost another game which they had no business losing. LSG are not sure what's happened. Hugs all around. Zaheer Khan run in and gives Avesh a hug. Smiles all around.

Straight up, straight up and Miller has dropped a relatively straightforward catch. What is happening? Knee-high full toss on off, he miscues this straight up to long-on. Miller runs forward and spills it
Oh, wow, he's absolutely nailed the yorker on middle. Hew can only jam this back to the bowler

Oh, he's flicked this straight to square leg. My word, that's a great catch by Thakur. Half-volley on Hetmyer's pad, a metre left of right of square leg and that was four. Instead, he nails this to Thakur who hangs on. Hetmyer is filthy with himself. But this game has changed again

Leading edge to deep point and Shardul fumbles to allow a second. Full outside off, he was looking to work this across the line and skews off the outside edge. The throw comes in and Pant tries to parry the ball back onto the stumps. Misses, the gloves hit the stumps, instead.
Nails a yorker first up on off stump, Jurel can only work that away to deep midwicket.

How's Hetmyer got that for four? Almost nails another yorker does Prince, but the line is just on leg stump. Hetmyer stays deep in his crease and tickles this past short fine leg for such a vital four.
Oh, that is a top bouncer. Banged in short on middle and Hetmyer has to away away from the line
That is a vital boundary. Low full toss well outside off. Hetmyer clears his front leg and slams this to the right of long-off
Fullish in length on middle stump, he whacks this across the line to deep midwicket. Samad hares forward going for the catch and then does well to get his body behind it
Nails the yorker on off stump, Hetmyer jams this back to the bowler
Almost another wicket. Pacy back of a length ball on chest-high. Jurel is very late on his pull and ends up splicing this to the on-side. Neither Prince nor Pant can reach to the ball in time.

Oh, dear, Parag is struck right in front and Avesh has a second wicket for the over. Is there life in this game, yet? Nails the yorker again on off stump, Parag shuffles across and looks for a cheeky scoop. Misses and is caught bang in front. He reviews, more in hope than anything else. In fact, Parag is almost at the boundary line by the time the third umpire confirms that the ball would have missed off, missed leg and thumped into middle stump.
Fuller in length outside off, Jurel drives to extra cover for a run
On a length on off stump, he pushes towards Markram's right at long-on and they get two this time around
Shin-high full too around off stump, Parag whips this to the left of deep midwicket. Himmat is quick onto the ball and keeps them down to a run
Pacy length ball at 138kph outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides to the right of deep third
The middle stump is flattened and Jaiswal's innings is cut short. Nails the yorker on middle. Jaiswal backs away, looking to go offside. Is beaten for pace and Avesh is pumped up.
Parag goes reverse but only manages to thump the length ball on the stumps straight to short third
Fullish in length on middle stump, Jaiswal sweeps to the right of short fine leg for a run
Flatter length ball on the stumps, Parag pushes to long-on for a run

Outside edge but falls short of short third. Fuller on leg stump. Jaiswal gives himself room and swings this across the line. Loses his shape completely, but luckily for him, the ball does not go to hand
Carrom ball outside off, Parag eases to long-on for a run
Gets an under-edge on it and four more to his name. Front of the hand length ball on off, he goes reverse and past short third
Low full toss on off stump that is tonked to long-off on the bounce by Parag
Nails the yorker on leg stump, Jaiswal once again clears his front leg and just about gets his bat down in time to squeeze this to mid-on for a quick run
Knee-high full toss outside off. Jaiswal gets his right leg out of the way and slices past point for four more
Another fuller-length delivery outside off, Parag is almost swept off his feet looking to hammer this across the line. Gets a thick inside-edge onto pad and Jaiswal sprints through for a run
SHOT! Misses his length and goes right in Parag's arc just outside off. He gets under it and pumps this over long-on with power
Nails the yorker after the break. Tailing back in on middle and leg, Parag just about gets his bat down in time and inside-edges this onto his pad
Low full toss on the pads of Parag, who whips this to deep backward square leg
Gloved/top-edged just over a diving Pant. Sharp back of a length ball cramping Parag for room. He ends up awkwardly pulling this and just about clears the keeper
Excellent fuller-length ball just around off stump, Jaiswal squeezes this to the left of a diving Prince to long-on
back of a length ball angling across Jaiswal who cuts but straight to point
Low full toss outside off, Jaiswal drives firmly to the right of long-off for a couple of runs

Stifle appeal but Parag was struck well outside the line. Was a slower back of a length ball outside off. Parag steps across and lines up for a scoop/pull over square leg. Misses and is hit on the thigh pad
Keeps the pace up on the good length ball outside off, Jaiswal mistimes his punch to extra cover
Fired in on a length on off stump, Parag eases this to long-on
Dragged down at 107.3kph on off, he pulls to the left of Badoni at deep midwicket for two
Darted on the stumps, Jaiswal gets this down to long-on
Almost sneaks through. Was a quicker length ball that fizzes through on middle and gets a thick inside edge on to pad. The ball trickles close to the stumps
Flatter length ball outside off, he punches to extra cover
Keeps it wicket to wicket on middle and leg, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad as he defends
On a length drifting away from Jaiswal just around off. He stays back and pushes to long-off for a run
Flatter 95kph length ball on off, he eases to long-off
Pushed quicker on leg stump, Jaiswal flat-bats to wide long-on

That goes for four despite point getting a hand on. Angles the ball on the shorter side, but the key was width. Jaiswal pounces on it and cuts it hard to the left of point. Bishnoi gets a hand, but still can't prevent the four
Pushed quicker on a length just around off stump, Jaiswal drives on the up through covers for a couple of runs
PUNCHED with power! Prince was aiming for the yorker again, but ends up overpitching this and Parag just holds his shape, presents the full face of the bat and goes straight over the bowler's head
Backs away and works the low full toss to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Nails the yorker on middle and there's nothing much Parag could do but to jam it back towards the bowler
On a length on middle and leg, he clips this neatly to wide long-on for a run. Was looking for a second there Parag, but the fielder was quick on to the ball
Fuller and on the pads of Parag, who flicks this neatly to deep square leg for a run
Helped for six! Half-volley on Parag's pad and that is a freebie that the RR captain accepts with flee. Shuffles across and helps this over deep backward square leg
On the fuller side outside off, Parag presents the full face of the bat and drives firmly to long-off
Pushed quicker on off stump, he defends towards point
Lovely timing and an equally great stop by Himmat at extra cover. Fuller in length outside off, he creams the drive and a few inches to the left of the fielder, and that would have been four
Fired fuller and down leg at 104.5kph. Pant does well to his left and saves a few extra runs
Flatter length ball driftin in on Jaiswal's pads. He clips to deep backward square leg where Samad is quick onto the ball and prevents a second
Dragged down on leg stump as Parag works this to short fine leg for a run
Flatter and on a length outside off, he creams the drive to long-off with a nice stretch forward

gone, taken at fine leg! This time the attempted pull finds the fielder. Another short delivery from Thakur, who bowled this around off, and got it to finish on middle again. This time Rana swivelled to pull, while not looking surprised by the length or the bounce. The ball, though, landed right in the lap of the fine-leg fielder
top edge, and six! Short ball from Thakur, who bowled just outside off. The ball was angled in, and finished around middle, as Rana took his eyes off while looking to pull it away
short of a length on off, and nudged to midwicket by getting slightly across
he walks down, and Thakur bowls it short and wide-ish of off. Eventually, Jaiswal swat-pulls to deep square leg with a tennis-batted shot
fuller length, and on middle. He looked to clip, but got an inside edge wide of the keeper's right
on a length, and on off. It straightens after pitching, and is pushed to extra cover
full again, but this is on middle and leg. Tucked towards square leg
full and slow on middle, and driven back to Markram

is he stumped?! Pant looks confident, and the square-leg umpire refers this. Yup, the first replay confirms that Suryavanshi's back leg is juuuuust above in the air when Pant whips the bails off. It was well bowled by Markram too, who slowed it down at Suryavanshi. It was angled in, and as Suryavanshi looked to lean and push forward, he missed this ball which ended outside leg
swipes at this short ball on leg to deep midwicket
full and slow on middle and off, and driven to long-off
on a length on leg, and turns away a bit. Nudged to deep midwicket to raise his fifty
ridiculous shot! No way it should have gone that far! He even seemed to have lost his balance while pulling at this short ball around off, and the ball went hard and flat over wide long-on
slower from Rathi, who gets this to dip on a length on middle and leg. Clipped to midwicket by Jaiswal
another shortish ball, and moves away to finish outside off. It is whipped with great wrists, and played wide of long-on
shortish in length, and outside off. It turns away, and is cut on the bounce to point
this dips on a length on leg, and shapes to turn away. Punched to deep midwicket
full and angling across to arrive just outside off. Driven to deep extra cover
on a fullish length on the stumps, and the ball straightens. Clipped to short fine leg
fuller and slower, and dipping on middle. Nudged to deep midwicket
hacked to deep extra cover! These two are taking it further away with every hit. Bishnoi went short, and around sixth stump, as Jaiswal crashed it for four more
slaps this shortish ball to deep cover, as Bishnoi bowls on off, and gets it to turn away to finish wide-ish of off
lofted down the ground! On a length on middle and off, and slower too, as Suryavanshi thumps it back over the non-striker's head
full and quick, and drifting towards off. Driven to extra cover
pulled over square leg! Five dots in the over, and the last ball is dumped for six. Prince bowls a slower ball, and goes short around off. Jaiswal shifts his weight back, and clubs the ball
a yorker on off as the ball angles across, and is driven to mid-off
lovely bowling! Jaiswal is ducking, swaying and struggling!! He walks down, and Prince bangs it short on middle. Jaiswal is left on his haunches, and the ball barely misses the grill of the helmet
he walks down, and converts this into a low full toss on off. Driven to extra cover for another dot
a loud appeal for lbw, but not given. It was on a short of a length on leg - in fact, replays show it was just outside leg - as Jaiswal looked to clip but missed
smacks his front pad! The ball was angled across, but swung in to land on a short of a length on middle and leg. It cramped Jaiswal for room, as he looked to push
full, and angling into middle and leg. Pushed to mid-on by leaning forward
he shapes to have a big heave, but eventually drives at this full, slow and dipping ball on off to long-off
angled across, and on a fullish length on middle and off. Punched to extra cover
powerful swing of the arms! He gets his front leg out of the way at this length ball just outside off, and clubs this over mid-on for another big six
slog swept over deep-backward square leg! Markram bowled on a short of a length, and just outside off, as the ball straightened, and Jaiswal took a good stride out to swing at that
short of a length on the stumps, and clipped to deep midwicket
slapped on the bounce to point, as this length ball turns away to finish just outside off
shorter side of a length on leg, and a hint of turn away. Swiped to midwicket
he looks to punch at this length ball arriving on off, but gets an inside edge on to his pad
fullish length on leg, and turns away again. It is pushed towards midwicket, and he takes off for a run, before Jaiswal sends him back
on a length on middle, and turning away to finish just outside off. Punched to long-off
on a short of a length on middle and leg, and turning away. Pushed to point
a swat-pull on the bounce to deep-backward square leg, as Jaiswal hooks this short ball on middle by playing right in front of his eyes
on a few bounces to the man running forward from deep-backward square leg, as he pulled at another short delivery on off or thereabouts. More luck for the teenager
a full toss, and this lands just beyond the pitch on a wide line outside off. Suryavanshi backed away and looked to slash, but missed
slower ball, and on the fuller side of a length on middle and off. It straightens after pitching, and is punched wide of mid-on
wow, the sound off the bat was fantastic!! That swivel and that pull has sent the ball deep over square leg. Short in length from Thakur just outside off, and Jaiswal tonks it for six
drilled between cover point and extra cover! Thakur angled it in, and bowled very full and on fifth stump. Jaiswal hung back, and smashed that back

double luck for RR and Suryavanshi!! What could have been taken a catch is not only dropped, but the ball also goes for four. Avesh banged the ball hard on a short length on off, and Suryavanshi unleashed a forceful pull. Prince, the man at midwicket turned around and went for the catch, with the ball dropping over his shoulder, but dropped the chance
short and wide of off from Avesh, and Jaiswal cuts hard to deep third
short in length on off, and it straightens. Jaiswal goes back to block
leading edge... lands between deep third coming forward and point going back! He attempted a helicopter shot at this fuller ball around off, but seemed to have closed the face of the bat too early
pumped down the ground! Very powerful from the kid! This is angled in, and on a fullish length around off, as Suryavanshi stays deep in the crease to dispatch that
pulled to deep-backward square leg. Short ball on off, as it angles in, and Jaiswal shifts his weight back to put that away
short ball on middle and off, and swat-pulled to deep midwicket
drilled to cover point. Thakur angles this in, and bowls a near yorker just outside off, as Suryavanshi opens the face of the bat to play at that for a single
smacks his first ball for six!! The ball flies over the extra-cover boundary! He backs away first ball, and creams this length ball around off with a flat-batted six
shorter side of a length on middle, and pushed wide of mid-on

whipped wide of long-on! There was a man at deep midwicket, but the ball went to his right. Thakur floated this fullish, and on middle and leg, as Jaiswal went through the line and leaned into the shot
angled across, and this is full on off. Driven back towards Thakur's right hand
